purpose: Classify the directly selected movement roots in the 0x001203D0-0x00120431 band, while retaining the conditional Type-0x15 entries as aliases and leaving the unreferenced 0x001203E8 loop unresolved.

streams.name: ACTOR_MOVE_TYPE50_LEVEL09_SPAWN
streams.producer: Level09_EnterRoutine at 0x001B619C writes the root into the newly initialized actor movement field

streams.name: ACTOR_MOVE_TYPE15_PROXIMITY_RESPONSE
streams.producer: ED at 0x001247F0 in ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE14_INTERACTION installs the root for the promoted type-0x15 response
decoded: The root begins with (+1, 0), (0, 0), and (+1, 0) movement steps, then compares actor/RAM fields and returns to 0x001203FA.

The conditional entry at 0x00120418 checks the same response field and returns to the root; the conditional target at 0x00120428 writes the encoded actor/animation value and clears movement state before the next known root at 0x00120432.
The complete owner includes both conditional entries through 0x00120431; they are aliases rather than separate ownership ranges.

unresolved.reason: The bytes decode as a valid 10-byte (+2,0)/(+1,0) self-loop, but no external template, F5 record, instruction reference, or named consumer currently selects this entry.

boundary_basis: The four compact roots are selected by exact actor-template fields or the direct Level09 caller write.
The Type-0x15 owner is bounded through its two conditional targets and immediately terminates before ACTOR_MOVE_TYPE1F_PROXIMITY_GATE at 0x00120432.
The 0x001203E8 bytes remain outside every promoted owner despite their valid decoder shape because their producer is not established.
